<title
    level="1"

    pfs=""
>
[Messenger's Ring](/Equipment.aspx?ID=448)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Enchantment" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=61" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Core Rulebook](/Sources.aspx?ID=1) pg. 613 <sup>4.0</sup>

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This silver signet ring changes to match the insignia of a lord or organization you serve (or your own face, if you serve no one else). It grants you a +2 item bonus to Diplomacy checks and lets you cast [_message_](/Spells.aspx?ID=190) as an arcane innate spell at will.

**Activate** <actions string="" /> 1 minute (envision);  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** The ring casts [_animal messenger_](/Spells.aspx?ID=11) to your specification. The animal is a magical creature that springs from the ring, and its appearance suits the iconography or heraldry of the lord or organization represented by the ring.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>
